copy.enterADeviceSyncPort165535.f14d0c: Enter a device sync port (1–65535) and choose a listening scope. For LAN access, choose LAN and use http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT. For remote access, forward a public IP/domain port to this NAS port, or choose localhost and use FRP, a reverse proxy or VPN to forward to 127.0.0.1:PORT. The sync port uses unencrypted HTTP by default; exposing it publicly risks scanning and unauthorized access. Use HTTPS, a VPN or a source-restricted reverse proxy, and protect pairing codes. Do not expose unnecessary ports. Restart this app from App Center after saving. Open the app from App Center; generate codes in Devices. Your current NAS account is used, with no separate registration.

installer.welcomeText:
This wizard will install Pome Panel.

Choose an installation folder on the next page. Shortcuts will be created on the desktop and in the Start menu.
installer.directoryText: Choose where to install Pome Panel. Program files will be stored there; a shortcut will be created on your desktop.
mac.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pome Panel uses the camera for the Mirror preview when you open it.
mac.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pome Panel uses the microphone to record audio when you start recording. Transcription is optional.
mac.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Pome Panel uses System Events to list and focus windows and send Soda Music shortcuts.
mac.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Pome Panel accesses your NAS on the local network to sync your workspace.
nas.packageDescription: View your Pome Panel workspace on the NAS and pair with the desktop app. The interface uses the unified gateway /app/pome-panel. The gateway starts even without a configured port. Device sync defaults to 127.0.0.1, with optional LAN listening on 0.0.0.0.
nas.packageChangelog: 0.9.14: Device sync supports optional LAN listening (0.0.0.0), with localhost (127.0.0.1) as the default. App Settings adds Listen scope. The startup entry remains TRIM_APPDEST/server and the sync protocol remains in target/packages/sync-protocol. Uninstall can keep or delete app data.
